reviews.text: Juan and his crew were punctual, executed great-quality work and left the job site (our back patio) neat each evening. 100% satisfied with our pool remodeling. Of the five remodelers, we only received a list of references and a copy of his bond/insurance from Juan during the bid phase. He was professional, honest and had one of the best prices of them all for the work agreed to including new travertine coping, tile and plaster.
reviews.author: Brian Whalen

reviews.text: The very premium plaster around the final main drain didn’t get the same mist treatment as the rest of the pool so it left a darker ring around it.  They said they would come back in September once it cooled but now they won’t answer our calls or return Messages.
reviews.author: Art Manasse

reviews.text: What can I say about Juan and his employees other than GREAT!!  Juan helped us turn our DIY in ground pool into a backyard beauty.  I called him to plaster our small plunge pool that my husband built himself.  He put the finishing touches on the pool by adding the tile surround and new coping.  His employees were on time, professional, hard working and cleaned up after each visit.  I would highly recommend J&M Pools!!
reviews.author: Karen Davenport

reviews.text: My stone and boulder pool is 31 years old and hadn’t been replastered since it was built. After becoming disabled in 2009, I wasn’t able to maintain it properly, and it needed major restoration. I’m so glad I found J&M Pool Plastering. Jesse was the foreman and represents the 'J' in the company name, and led an excellent, professional crew. His communications were excellent and he constantly kept me informed as they ran into unforseen problems, and there were a few on the old pool, and always gave me good options. His father, Juan, who started the company 37 years ago, personally helped resolve a difficult pool light issue and went above and beyond to make sure it was fixed. He also helped identify some early settling cracks in the shell, and showed up to explain them to me before they expertly and permanently repaired them with staples and epoxy. They sealed the stone around the entire pool, filled cracks between the boulders and walkway, and treated every part of the job with care and respect for my property. They even did things here and there for me that were not on the work order. Just plain, good people! Their hard work, integrity, and craftsmanship were nothing short of heroic and was impeccable. I now consider them friends. The Tahoe Blue quartz finish I chose looks absolutely beautiful. A heartfelt thank you to Jesse, Juan, Ana, and the entire J&M team! My pool is beautiful and I'll think of you when I'm in it. I'll add Photos when the startup is done. No question, you've found the best!
reviews.author: Paul L.

reviews.text: Bad plaster job.  Not even two months old and sundeck chipped, pox marks/divets in bottom surface of pool. Owner said that's normal, supposed to look this way, even though three other companies told me it's a bad plaster job.  Gave owner option to do the right thing and either re-do plaster completely, or give me a full refund.  He refused.  Told me he would re-do it, but when the outcome is the same I'll have to pay him again.  Very unhappy. Out almost $5000 and have to go with someone else to re-do entire job.  Take a look at the pictures - speaks for itself.
reviews.author: C MedBou

reviews.text: Having some issues with the mastic that started pulling away from the coping after only 5 weeks. When Juan came out to inspect, we were told that this was ground movement. The fact is  the mastic was not applied properly and needs to be redone. As Juan has refused to address the issue, this has now become a legal matter! It's unfortunate the contractors don't stand behind their work.
reviews.author: Andy Alhadef

reviews.text:
Juan and his crew have been amazing during our pool build.    They did our beautiful outdoor kitchen, our tile, plaster, tile and coping and among everything else you can think of they did it beautifully and was very professional and just wonderful to work with.

And when issues came up that was out of anyone’s control they came in and save the day, always willing to lend a hand to help fix the problems and of course they fixed it with ease!

You will never find a better company then Juan and his crew! I recommend them to everyone that needs a pool re-remodel and or new plaster!

Again thank you for everting you have done for us!
reviews.author: Denise Wiley

reviews.text: We are very pleased with the outstanding work performed by J&M Pool Plastering.  We had several estimates, and all though they were NOT the cheapest estimate, we chose to go with Juan and his team because in talking to Juan, I knew he was a man I could trust (Juan is the owner).  We are glad we did!  They provided exceptional value for the work performed. All of the work and the products they used were of very high quality, performed in a timely manner, and clean up was impeccable.  The crews were very knowledgeable and took the time to ensure a high degree of customer satisfaction. Juan and his guys were always available to answer questions and kept me informed as the work progressed.  My thirty year old pool looks fantastic.  We absolutely love the new look! His man, Manuel came out everyday for 7 days strait after the work was completed to make sure everything was good (I paid $500 for the start up package which I highly recommend).  About 2 weeks after they’d completed the work, I had suspected the pool might be losing  too much water.  When I contacted Juan about the suspected problem, his response was immediate and he said exactly this "we will take care of this for you."  On May 14, 2018, they made a repair to the “throat” of the skimmer basket.  It was quite involved and took Manuel half the day.  A few days after they made this repair, I contacted Juan and told him I was still concerned I was losing water someplace.  Juan assured me if there is a problem he would make sure it was fixed to my satisfaction.  He sent his guy Manuel out again and he got in the water (which was freezing) and double/triple checked everything.  He took the time to show me the pool was sealed tightly and there are no leaks.  This is a super great company with super great people.  I wish everybody did business with the integrity J&M does.  Thanks again Juan!
